effect.name: Palette Ramp
effect.description: Re-colours by brightness through a palette strip you supply as an image, instead of the four hard-coded stops Gradient Map gives you. Draw a 1-pixel-tall strip of your palette, drop it in, and the whole game wears it.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Ramp Length
parameter.description: How many colours across your strip is. Must match the image or the ends will be sampled wrong.

parameter.name: Ramp Rows
parameter.description: How many palettes are stacked vertically in the image.

parameter.name: Row
parameter.description: Which row to read. Animate this to swap palettes.

parameter.name: Offset
parameter.description: Slides every pixel along the ramp before it is looked up.

parameter.name: Contrast
parameter.description: Spreads the brightness range across the ramp.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the re-coloured pixel back over the original.

parameter.name: Palette Ramp
parameter.description: The palette strip. Darkest colour on the left, lightest on the right.
